new_entities.name: Long-term inclisiran therapy
new_entities.description: Long-term treatment with inclisiran, a small interfering RNA therapy targeting PCSK9 synthesis, usually given after initial and 3-month doses and then every 6 months.

new_entities.name: LDL cholesterol reduction
new_entities.description: Reduction in circulating low-density lipoprotein cholesterol over time.

edges.effect_quant: Across ORION-10 and ORION-11, inclisiran lowered LDL-C by about 50% at day 510, and ORION-8 showed the effect remained durable over a mean cumulative exposure of 3.7 years with a mean LDL-C change of -49.4%. Meta-analysis of randomized trials found a pooled LDL-C lowering effect of roughly 48% to 51%.
edges.population: adults with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, ASCVD risk equivalents, or familial hypercholesterolemia who have elevated LDL cholesterol despite standard lipid-lowering therapy
edges.mechanism: Inclisiran silences hepatic PCSK9 synthesis through RNA interference, increasing LDL-receptor recycling and sustaining marked LDL lowering with infrequent dosing.
edges.summary: This is one of the cleaner long-term lipid-lowering edges in the dataset. The LDL effect is large, durable, and unusually convenient from an adherence standpoint because maintenance dosing is only twice yearly.
edges.caveats: The lipid effect is strong, but long-term hard-outcome data are still less mature than the LDL reduction signal itself. The edge therefore focuses on LDL lowering rather than overclaiming definitive event prevention.

evidence.citation: Ray KK et al 2020 N Engl J Med
evidence.notes: Two Phase 3 Trials of Inclisiran in Patients with Elevated LDL Cholesterol. ORION-10 and ORION-11.

effect_quant.comparator: placebo-corrected LDL-C percentage change at day 510 in ORION-10 with inclisiran

evidence.citation: Wright RS et al 2024 Eur Heart J
evidence.notes: Inclisiran administration potently and durably lowers LDL-C over an extended-term follow-up: the ORION-8 trial.

effect_quant.comparator: mean LDL-C percentage change at end of study in ORION-8 with long-term inclisiran exposure

evidence.citation: Khan SA et al 2020 Am J Cardiol
evidence.notes: Meta-Analysis of Inclisiran for the Treatment of Hypercholesterolemia.

effect_quant.comparator: pooled LDL-C percentage change with inclisiran versus placebo across randomized trials
